That if any person shall use any vulgar or profane language in the presence or hearing of ladies or shali be guilty of any act of public indecency in said Town shall be Fined not less than five nor more than twenty-five dollars or work on the streets not less than ten nor more than thirty days.

1890

That any person who shali be guilty of creating a disturbance or any unnecessary whooping or loud screaming, gambling or fighting or quarreling or disorderly conduct in said town shall be fined not less than one nor more than twenty-five dollars or work on streets not less than two nor more than thirty days.
